Name: Joja ruins 9-Heart Shane Event (pretty much outdated)
Author: PanTran
Description:
I wanted Shane to at least acknowledge that he lost his job. So instead, I added an all-new event. He talks about how he's going to be moving forward happily in life thanks to you and your support. It's a proper farewell to the hellhole that is Joja

EDIT: per request, I've added a 7 heart version. It's the exact same, but triggers at 7 hearts instead of 9. the event isn't romantic, so it works either way,

EDIT2: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/15954444]Belysaght[/url] helped me with some minor typos!

Simply extract into the mods folder and you should be good to go.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2351?]Portrait mod shown in previews is PencilStabs Portraits![/url]

HOW TO ACTIVATE EVENT
[spoiler]  On a rainy, stormy, or snowy day., walk into town between 12 and 6 pm. You must have at least 9 hearts with him, and seen his 6-heart event already. The most important factor is that the community center must be finished.[/spoiler]

Downloads.Description: exact same as normal, but triggers at 7 instead of 9. the event isn't super romantic, so it can be taken either way.
